Fixed the persistence bug in [User.php](/app/var/workspaces/mass-assignment-silent-drop--laravel-13--1/app/Models/User.php).
Root cause: `timezone` and `marketing_opt_in` were missing from `$fillable`, so Laravel silently discarded them during `$user->update(...)`. Added both fields while keeping `is_admin` non-mass-assignable.
Verification: full PHPUnit suite passes.
